notes.title: ♠️ Celebrate Women’s Day with Soulitaire 🔮
notes.notes:
Hi lovely fortune-tellers! 🔮

This Women’s Day, we invite you to step into the world of Soulitaire, a cozy fortune-telling narrative game with solitaire where every card holds a story.

As the owner of a mystical café, you listen to visitors, read their fortunes, and maybe even change their fate—one card at a time. The free demo is available, so why not take a moment to slow down, play a game, and meet some interesting souls? ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254050/d519bc81f1f93db363c930e1d4952254c5bff2ca.png[/img]

☕ Try the free demo
♠️ Read the cards, shape the stories
💬 We’d love to hear your thoughts!

Thanks for being here, and happy Women’s Day 💖
Anke ~

notes.title: Soulitaire in Real Life
notes.notes:
Hi fortune-tellers!
This month we had the pleasure of presenting Soulitaire at the Hamburg Games Conference in Germany. Different people played Souli and gave us feedback. It is so helpful to get these insights!

But the best part about events is that we actually get to see you folks! This photo was taken by event photographer Rolf Otzipka.
Look at these two playing Soulitaire! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254050/bc3aa5eb7fb9c8c5925646fa24c08c5f3aa0c8c2.jpg[/img]

It is warming my heart <3~
I'm so glad that so many people are enjoying and playing our game.
Thanks also to everyone for the feedback in the Steam community!

See ya <(^-^<)~
Anke

notes.title: First Alpha Demo of Soulitaire
notes.notes:
Hi fortune-tellers!
Nice to meet you! I'm Anke from Beardshaker Games - my English is not the best, but I want to tell you about Soulitaire! ( No worries. The English inside the game was translated by a Pro ;] )

Beardshaker Games is an indie studio with 3 people. We wanted to make a really special game, where unusual things come together. Last year my partner Micha walked many times around with me to come up with this concept. My partner Bene was programming the first prototype to bring this idea to live.
Micha is a stunning artist and developed step by step this beautiful style. Rio has evolved to this wonderful character.

I'm glad to have two partners, who share the passion for game development and Souli with me. And I'm happy to be the one, who can share our first alpha demo with you.

To be honest: It is a little embarrassing to show a game which is right in the making. But we are also curious how do you like it! What do you see? How do you feel? What do you wish for?
Please share your thoughts with us to form Soulitaire into the best possible version of this game ~

I'd really adore your support - so, if you like Souli consider leaving a wishlist :]

Cheers,
Beardshaker Anke
